_meta.description: Class A.5 boundary auditors. Per the swarm-pilot-five-gap-hardening decision (2026-05-25): Bugs 1, 5, 6 were all process-boundary failures (process<->composite step identity, process<->process pipeline, process<->shared store). 28 inside-process auditors cannot find another Bug 6 by construction. These 4 auditors run in parallel with Class A, findings-only, same artifact contract (template at CLASS_A_TEMPLATE.md, adapted scope).

boundaries.name: M1MetabolismToSubstratesStore
boundaries.scope: M1 (Metabolism) <-> shared substrates store. Audit: writeback semantics, fba_sub_idx -> 1686 mapping, dynamic_bounds=False flag (Bug 3 territory), substrate init values (Bug 2 territory: _M1_SUBSTRATE_DEFAULT, _updater: accumulate).
key_questions: Are substrate initial counts pulled from Karr fixture or hardcoded?
Does accumulate updater semantics match Karr's per-tick delta model?
Is dynamic_bounds wired to fixture-driven enzyme bounds, or static?
Does writeback correctly cover all 504 FBA reactions' substrate deltas?

boundaries.name: AllocatorToConsumerProcesses
boundaries.scope: KarrAllocationStep <-> 28 consumer processes. Audit: who is enrolled vs who actually consumes; request/grant cycle integrity; ASSERT_POSITIVE_COUNTS coverage (sprint0); the karr_rna_decay/karr_host_interaction enrollment story (Bucket A).
key_questions: Full list of declared consumers vs full list of processes that actually write substrates?
Any consumer that drains a substrate without an allocator request?
Are tx + tl currently NOT enrolled? (Track A's target — confirm + cite)
Does ASSERT_POSITIVE_COUNTS fire on every write path or only the request path?

boundaries.name: TranscriptionToTranslationPipeline
boundaries.scope: karr_transcription <-> karr_translation. Audit: mRNA produced by TX is the same identity TL consumes; ribosome allocation across the pipeline; codon-to-AA mapping; step identity bug (Bug 1: _mark_instance_as_step at karr_composite.py:1873) and its TX/TL impact.
key_questions: Is TX dt actually firing post-Bug-1? (raw CSV check on karr_transcription.csv row count vs tick count)
Does TL consume the same mRNA store TX writes? Key-by-key audit.
Are ribosome counts shared correctly between the two?
Does the step identity bug (Bug 1) affect any other process pair the same way?

boundaries.name: ChassisToKarrStepHarness
boundaries.scope: build_karr_chassis_v6 <-> KarrAllocationStep + sub-process step registration. Audit: instantiation order, _mark_instance_as_step semantics, Bug 1's root site, what other invariants the chassis silently assumes about Process vs Step identity.
key_questions: Full inventory of every _mark_instance_as_step call site (Bug 1 root)
What does is_step=True actually change in Vivarium scheduling? (dt=0 implication)
Are there other processes inadvertently flagged as steps?
Does the chassis registry know which Processes are Steps vs Processes, or is identity inferred?
